blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano and his sister, Sen. Pia Cayetano, scrutinized the Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA) on Monday over its supposed focus on inspecting projects in Taguig City. The senators pointed out the LLDA’s seemingly “special interest” in Taguig City, led by Sen. Alan’s wife, Mayor Lani Cayetano, despite the agency’s jurisdiction over the Calabarzon region and other places in Metro Manila, such as Muntinlupa City. Sen. Alan asked LLDA Acting General Manager Leopoldo Parumog about the agency’s inspections of developments along the Laguna de Bay shoreline.
